name: walkley-data
description: Three lookups through a hosted MCP server: is a date a working day in mainland China (State Council holidays and weekend makeup workdays), known OSV.dev advisories for one exact npm, PyPI, Go, crates.io or Maven package version, and recent SEC Form 4 insider trades for a US company. 20 free calls per IP per day for the first two; past that, and always for insider trades, a tool answers with a paid x402 URL (USDC on Base) that this plugin cannot pay.
